title: ComboBox
description: Fiori combo box: free-text field with type-ahead filtering, inline autocomplete and the SAP keyboard model.

usage.summary: Choose one suggested value by typing, with filtering and optional free-text entry.
useWhen: Let users find one suggested value by typing, typically across 20–200 options.
Use the picker arrow to show choices before the user types. Validate the committed value when selection from the list is required.
Keep selection in a field when one suggestion label is enough to identify the value.
Choose filter for the supplied ComboBoxItem entries; onCommit receives text and onSelectionChange reports a matched item or null.

avoidWhen.when: Choose one of 2–12 predefined options without typing or free text; sort alphabetically above 8. Use Input for free text with optional suggestions.
Collect several values: fewer than 200 predefined options need MultiComboBox; free-form, caller-validated entries or datasets above 200 need MultiInput.
Find a value above 200 entries, search several attributes, or define conditions in a separate search task.
Browse business items with List or expand a hierarchy with Tree rather than choose a field value.
Submit a content-search query with optional scopes rather than choose a field value.
